import math
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, box
Rt=25; Rr=22; N=12; off=25
verts=[((Rr if k%2==0 else Rt)*math.cos(math.radians((k//2)*360/N + (0 if k%2==0 else off))), (Rr if k%2==0 else Rt)*math.sin(math.radians((k//2)*360/N + (0 if k%2==0 else off)))) for k in range(2*N)]
for fx0 in [24.2, 23.2]:
    rect=box(fx0,-0.75,28.5,0.75)
    print('=== finger x0',fx0)
    for gap in [37.3333333, 57.5, 27.5]:
        def area(m):
            rot=math.radians(-gap+m)
            c,s=math.cos(rot),math.sin(rot)
            vr=[(x*c-y*s, x*s+y*c) for x,y in verts]
            return Polygon(vr).intersection(rect).area
        frees=[round(area(m),3) for m in [0,-5,-10,-13,-15,-17,-20,-25,-30]]
        locks=[round(area(m),3) for m in [0,2,4,6,8,10,12,14]]
        print(f'gap {gap}: free {frees} lock {locks}')
